plan_item: v4.3 item 3 - A4 Combat effects and hit feedback (Art Bot): hit flashes, damage numbers, screen shake option

enemy_sprite_tint.how: existing shader uniforms uFlash / uFlashCol on the billboard (game.js already sets def.flash = 1)

player_hurt_screen.how: stretch over the 3D view, alpha = 0.55 * redFlash, decay ~350ms (current redFlash timing); replaces the flat rgba(200,20,20,0.35) fill with a red edge vignette

crit_screen.how: optional 1-2 frame pop on player crits, alpha 0.45 then 0 over 120ms

sprite.use: generic white/red spark drawn on any hit, under the element impact

map.critical: crit (draw CRIT word above the number, 1.5x)

damage_numbers.motion: pop in at 1.3x -> 1.0x over 80ms, rise ~0.5 world units, fade alpha = 1 - (t/life)^2, life 950ms (same as addFloat)

screen_shake_option.setting: Off / Low / Full (default Full); Low = 50% magnitude, Off = 0
screen_shake_option.units: [magnitude px, ms] as passed to shake(m, d)

impact_slash.blend: normal (alpha); additive also fine for all but blunt/poison/frost
